title: Columbia University's aiX Weekly Highlights AI Peer Review and Human Verification Risks
snippet: Columbia University's aiX Weekly highlights a human-subjects study showing that reviewers verifying AI output grew more confident in wrong answers. It also covers Princeton's Arvind Narayanan's ICML keynote warning that automating peer review is 'a trap' that cedes control of research direction.

title: HEPI Analysis Warns AI Detection Tools Create Student Due-Process Crisis
snippet: The Higher Education Policy Institute (HEPI) examines how unreliable AI detection tools are creating a student due-process crisis, particularly for international students. The analysis argues that universities must suspend AI detection as primary evidence in misconduct proceedings and focus on assessment redesign.
